about_the_game:
Ergo Sum – A progression-focused MMORPG with an original soundtrack, featuring aesthetics inspired by Legend of Mana and mechanics from Ragnarok.

100% FREE-TO-PLAY • NO PAY-TO-WIN

✦ AN OPEN WORLD THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME

Abandon generic, repetitive quests!

4 Arcane Academy options with unique admission exams - gain exclusive attributes depending on your class.

✦ CHOOSE YOUR PLAYSTYLE:

  • Warrior ➜ Knight - Lancer - Templar - Berserker

  • Mage ➜ Flame Warlock - Storm Warlock - Arctic Warlock - Geomancer

  • Rogue ➜ Brawler - Assassin - Ninja - Renegade

  • Priest ➜ Sage - Bishop - Shaman - Monk

  • Marksman ➜ Archer - Hunter - Pirate - Commander

✦ AT 4TH CLASS, CHOOSE YOUR PATH AMONG 3 UNIQUE DESTINIES!

  • Guardian - Magistrate - Bloodthirsty

  • Occultist - Sorcerer - Archmage

  • Executioner - Justiciar - Reaper

  • Pilgrim - Ansião - Inquisitor

  • Sentinel - Forest Warden - Major

✦ SYSTEMS THAT MAKE THE DIFFERENCE

• Diversity → Monsters have species, sizes, elements - kill enough to register them in the Explorer's Album
• Equipment → Rare cards (dropped from monsters), accessories, refinements, gems
• Deep Customization → Change character appearance, skill effects
• Pets vs Mercenaries → Choose between passive buffs 🐾 OR battle allies ⚔️
• Multiple Professions → Gain attribute rewards by mastering each profession

• Build diversity → We have several types of builds with basic, secondary, constellation, and specialization attributes.

✦ MEANINGFUL MULTIPLAYER

→ Complex mentoring system (help newcomers!)
→ Group dungeons with scalable rewards
→ Competitive PvP between players and Academy tournaments

© 2025 Ergo Sum — All rights reserved.

name: Ergo Sum
short_description: Ergo Sum is a free-to-play pixel art MMORPG with a charming open world. Play with friends or make new ones, explore a vast array of classes and evolutions, gain admission to an arcane school, and collect rare monster cards. Grow stronger with each passing day.
